seo.h1: Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) Guide
seo.title: SGN Airport Guide: Tan Son Nhat Terminals & Transit | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Vietnam busiest aviation hub: terminals, transport & essential tips
seo.meta_description: Complete passenger transit and terminal guide for Tan Son Nhat Airport (SGN) in Ho Chi Minh City. Includes express bus routes, Grab pick-up points, lounge access, and departure tips.

faqs.answer: It is roughly 8 km north of District 1. Travel time is typically 30 to 50 minutes depending on rush-hour traffic.
faqs.question: How far is Tan Son Nhat Airport from District 1?

faqs.answer: Yes, a sheltered pedestrian corridor connects Domestic Terminal 1 and International Terminal 2. The walk takes approximately 5 minutes.
faqs.question: Can I walk between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2?

faqs.answer: For Terminal 2 arrivals, walk across Lane B to the ground floor pick-up bays or the multi-level TCP parking structure.
faqs.question: Where do I catch a Grab car at SGN?

steps.body: Follow arrival signage to Ground Floor passport control. Visa-on-arrival counter is situated directly before the main passport control desks.
steps.title: 1. Passport Control & Visa

steps.body: Retrieve checked baggage from belts 1-6. All international arrivals must pass customs X-ray screening before exiting to the public arrival hall.
steps.title: 2. Baggage Reclaim & Customs

steps.body: Official telecom kiosks (Viettel, Vinaphone) and licensed currency exchange booths line the exit lobby. Proceed to Lane B or D for app-based taxis.
steps.title: 3. SIM Cards, Currency & Transport

arrival.summary: Arrival procedures for domestic and international passengers landing at Tan Son Nhat.

lounges.name: Lotus Lounge (T2 International)
lounges.access_summary: Business Class passengers, SkyTeam Elite Plus, Lotusmiles Platinum, or walk-in lounge pass (~$35 USD)

lounges.name: Le Saigonnais Business Lounge
lounges.access_summary: Priority Pass, DragonPass, and selected airline premium passengers

notices.body: A brand new passenger terminal (T3) is slated for domestic expansion. Expect periodic road diversions around Truong Son entrance.
notices.title: Terminal T3 Construction Underway

notices.body: Ignore unsolicited touts inside the arrival hall claiming to be Grab or metered drivers. Only board cars in official queue lanes.
notices.title: Beware Unofficial Taxi Touts

steps.body: International flights depart from T2 2nd Floor; domestic flights depart from T1. Online check-in bag drop closes 60 minutes before scheduled departure.
steps.title: 1. Terminal & Check-in Desk

steps.body: Automated e-Gates are available for eligible biometric passport holders. Security requires laptops and liquids placed in separate trays.
steps.title: 2. Immigration & Security Check

steps.body: VAT refund verification counter is located airside near Gate 17. Boarding commences 40 minutes prior to departure.
steps.title: 3. Boarding Gates & VAT Refund

departure.summary: Departure check-in, security, and boarding gates guide.

terminals.name: International Terminal (All foreign carriers & intl flights)

transport.summary: Air-conditioned yellow express bus directly connecting SGN to central Saigon hotels.
transport.pickup_location_summary: Column 12, Terminal 2 Ground Floor (outside arrival gate)

transport.name: GrabCar / Be
transport.summary: App-based ride-hailing with upfront transparent fares without risk of meter tampering.
transport.pickup_location_summary: Lane D / TCP Parking Garage 3rd-5th floors

transport.name: Metered Taxi (Vinasun / Mai Linh)
transport.summary: Reputable traditional metered taxi companies drop off right outside departure check-in doors.
transport.pickup_location_summary: Flag down in city or call dispatch hotlines

facilities.name: Tourist eSIM & SIM Cards
facilities.summary: Official Viettel and Vinaphone counters at T2 arrivals lobby offering 4G/5G data packages from 200,000 VND.

facilities.name: ATMs & Currency Exchange
facilities.summary: Vietcombank, BIDV, and HSBC ATMs located in both departure and arrival lobbies.

facilities.name: Free High-Speed Wi-Fi & Charging
facilities.summary: Complimentary "FreeWifi TanSonNhat Airport" available throughout both passenger terminals.

orientation.intro: Welcome to Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN), the main international gateway to Southern Vietnam located just 8 km north of downtown Ho Chi Minh City.
orientation.summary: With two connected terminals handling domestic (T1) and international (T2) flights, SGN accommodates over 38 million passengers annually.
